messages:
Maria (oncall): handing off shift — I'm live until 18:00 UTC then Sam takes over. quick FYI about tonight's release and a few small risk items.
Kevin (infra): thanks — noted. which release is going out and what's the blast radius?
Maria (oncall): checkout-service v3.4.1 at 20:30 UTC. rolling canary 10% for 15m -> 50% -> 100% if green. targeted pods across eu-west & us-central.
Olivia (checkout): devs ran smoke locally. main risk is a short DB index backfill that runs during canary and may bump replica lag ~1-3s for a couple minutes. we've throttled it but watch DB replica lag.
Maria (oncall): expected transient 5xx spike is low but set alerts: latency > 600ms for 3min OR errors > 0.5% in canary window. watchers: @Kevin, @Olivia. Sam will be primary pager at full roll.
Kevin (infra): I wired canary alerts to #pager oncall and added a temporary autoscaler rule: scale-target +10% if 95th latency > 800ms. if autoscale doesn't kick, we can abort rollout.
Maria (oncall): rollback command in case: `/ops rollout rollback checkout-service v3.4.0` — tested last week. also run quick smoke:```\nkubectl --context=prod get pods -l app=checkout -o wide\ncurl -sS -H "x-test: smoke" https://checkout.prod.hq/api/health | jq .status\n```
Sam (oncall-cover): I'll be on-call from 18:00 UTC onward. I'll keep my phone on and monitor canary. ping me @Sam if anything noisy.
deploy-bot: Canary started for checkout-service v3.4.1 at 20:31:12 UTC (canary weight 10%). Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/checkout/canary/2146123060
Olivia (checkout): running the final keyset of smoke prompts now. will post pass/fail in ~10m.
Maria (oncall): one more note — freeze window for infra config changes from 20:15-21:45 UTC. no additional infra deploys during that time unless urgent.
Sam (oncall-cover): got it. I'll escalate to oncall lead if we hit the threshold. good handoff, Maria :thumbsup:
Olivia (checkout): smoke OK — no errors in canary traffic for 12m. continuing ramp per plan.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 50% at 20:47:30 UTC completed. monitoring metrics.
Kevin (infra): watching DB replica lag dashboard now — will call out if lag > 5s.
Sam (oncall-cover): thanks everyone — taking over notes and coverage. I'll post a short post-deploy summary after 21:45 UTC.
